title: 第246章 问罪巫尸第245章 并不无辜
content_zh:
话音一落。
眼前的虚空，骤然坍塌，仿佛形成一条空间通道。
一个身姿挺拔，眉眼温和的少年，从空间甬道之中，缓缓走出。
走出空间通道后，他便立于半空，神情淡漠的望着前方。
紧接着。
身穿黑色劲装，面容冷峻的南冥王，跟随在少年身后，缓步而行。
对于这位尸蛮国的南冥王，巫言衡自然不陌生。
只是他一时也想不通，为何这位也会出现在这里？
随后是狐仙儿，鹿香郎，虎宪章，以及悬浮在虎宪章头顶的一缕白色残魂。
巫言衡湛蓝色的眼眸，缓缓掠过众人，最后定格在最前面的少年身上，拱手躬身，微微一拜：“行者大人驾临我巫尸国，使我朝蓬荜生辉，老朽代表天子，在此迎接。”
随着巫言衡躬身行礼，其身后不远处，十万巫尸士卒，亦在此刻齐齐一拜：“恭迎行者大人！”
声如雷洪，响彻天穹。
姜峰静静地看着面前白发黑袍的老者，未有任何言语。
来巫尸国之前，南冥王已经向他详细介绍了巫尸国的情况。
巫尸国的国师，名为巫言衡，修行尸狱独有的巫虫之术，以虫驭尸，以巫敕魂，实力完全不在颜守卿之下。
巫虫之术，与尸鬼之术，也算异曲同工。
巫言衡与颜守卿之间的争斗，也持续了许多年，一直未分胜负。
当然，这位巫尸国师的实力就算真的不弱于颜守卿，那又如何呢？
还不是乖乖站在边境线上，恭迎大驾。
别人顶多是出府迎接，这位巫尸国师属于是出国迎接了。

更何况。
此番抵达边境的，也不止巫言衡一人，还有戍守边境的十万将士。
面子给的足足的，架子抬的高高的。
巫尸国以这样的方式，向姜峰表示臣服之意。
但，姜峰只是俯瞰着他，始终不曾出声，也任由巫言衡，以及十万巫尸边军，保持着躬身行礼的姿势，连半句客套话也没说。
这种沉默，让此方天地的气氛，渐渐变得凝肃起来。
任是谁都看得出来，姜峰对这位巫尸国师，或者说对整个巫尸国，并未有任何好感。
姜峰一直没有说话，巫言衡便一直没有起身。
他不知这位天宫行者的脾性，他只知道，心怀不轨，出言不逊的颜守卿，正是死在眼前之人的手下。
尸蛮国因此迎来了亡国之危，而巫尸国绝对不能步其后尘。
故而，无论姜峰接下来说什么，做什么，想怎么做，巫尸国都绝无异议。
别说只是让他保持躬身行礼，就算是让他三跪九叩，又有何妨？
总好过去阴曹地府与颜守卿做伴。
许久后。
少年淡然的声音，在这边境之上，缓缓传开：“巫国师不用紧张，我此来巫尸国，乃是为了办三件事。”
巫言衡还未开口询问，姜峰便直接说道：
content_en:
The words fell.
The void in front of him suddenly collapsed, as if forming a space passage.
A young man with a tall and straight body and gentle eyebrows slowly walked out of the space corridor.
After walking out of the space passage, he stood in mid-air, looking ahead with an indifferent expression.
Immediately afterwards.
Nan Pluto, who was wearing a black outfit and a stern face, followed the young man and walked slowly.
Naturally, Wu Yanheng was no stranger to the Nan Pluto King of the Corpse Barbarian Kingdom.
But he couldn't figure it out for a moment, why would this person appear here?
Then came Fox Fairy, Lu Xianglang, Tiger Charter, and a wisp of white residual soul suspended above Tiger Charter's head.
Wu Yanheng's blue eyes slowly glanced over the crowd, and finally settled on the young man in the front. He bowed his hands and bowed slightly: "Master Xingzhe has come to my Kingdom of Wu Corpse to make me shine. On behalf of the emperor, I am here to welcome him."
As Wu Yanheng bowed and saluted, not far behind him, a hundred thousand witch corpse soldiers also bowed together at this moment: "Welcome to you, Sir Monk!"
The sound was like a thunderstorm, resounding across the sky.
Jiang Feng looked at the white-haired and black-robed old man in front of him quietly without saying a word.
Before coming to the Witch Corpse Kingdom, Nan Pluto had introduced him to the situation in the Witch Corpse Kingdom in detail.
The national master of the Witch Corpse Kingdom is named Wu Yanheng. He practices the witch insect technique unique to the Corpse Prison. He uses insects to control corpses and uses witchcraft souls. His strength is not inferior to that of Yan Shouqing.
The art of witches and insects is similar to the art of corpses.
The battle between Wu Yanheng and Yan Shouqing continued for many years, and there was no winner.
Of course, even if the strength of this Shaman Corpse Master is really not weaker than Yan Shouqing, so what?
It's better to stand obediently on the border and welcome the arrival.
Others at best went out of their homes to greet him, but this Shaman Corpse Master went abroad to greet him.
not to mention.
Wu Yanheng was not the only one who arrived at the border this time, there were also 100,000 soldiers guarding the border.
The face is given abundantly, and the airs are held high.
In this way, the Witch Corpse Kingdom expressed its surrender to Jiang Feng.
However, Jiang Feng just looked down at him and never said a word. He also allowed Wu Yanheng and the 100,000 witch corpse soldiers to keep bowing and saluting without even saying a polite word.
This kind of silence made the atmosphere in this world gradually become solemn.
Anyone could tell that Jiang Feng did not have any good impressions of the Wizard Corpse Kingdom Master, or the entire Wizard Corpse Kingdom.
Jiang Feng remained silent, and Wu Yanheng never stood up.
He didn't know the temperament of this Tiangong Walker. He only knew that Yan Shouqing, who had evil intentions and rude words, died at the hands of the person in front of him.
As a result, the Corpse Barbarian Kingdom is facing the danger of national subjugation, and the Witch Corpse Kingdom must not follow in its footsteps.
Therefore, no matter what Jiang Feng says, what he does, or how he wants to do it, the Witch Corpse Kingdom will never object.
Not to mention just asking him to keep bowing and saluting, even if you ask him to kneel three times and kowtow, what's the harm?
It would be better to go to the underworld and keep Yan Shouqing company.
After a long time.
The young man's calm voice slowly spread across the border: "Master Wu Guo, don't be nervous. I came to Wu Zhiguo to do three things."
Before Wu Yanheng asked, Jiang Feng said directly:
